acceptance: The pypi-publish job in publish.yml succeeds on tagged releases without exchange failures.
Tagged releases publish wheels and sdists to PyPI automatically.
context:
Observed during v0.10.0 and v0.10.1 releases: github-release succeeded, but pypi-publish failed with 'Trusted publishing exchange failure'. Past releases (v0.7.2, v0.8.0, v0.9.1) showed the same failure.

2026-10-31: still failing on v0.11.0 (Publish run https://github.com/joeharris76/todo-db/actions/runs/40806736446): build and github-release succeeded; pypi-publish failed with `invalid-publisher` ("valid token, but no corresponding publisher"). https://pypi.org/pypi/todo-db/json returns 404, so no todo-db project exists on PyPI yet. The fix is a pending trusted publisher on PyPI for owner joeharris76, repository todo-db, workflow publish.yml, environment `pypi` (publish.yml line 54). The done item publish-todo-db-to-pypi does not reflect this: no release has reached PyPI.
description: In .github/workflows/publish.yml, the pypi-publish job has failed on every release since v0.7.2 (including v0.10.0 and v0.10.1) with 'Trusted publishing exchange failure'. The PyPI project 'todo-db' needs the GitHub repository environment / trusted publisher configuration configured on PyPI so tagged releases automatically publish to PyPI alongside GitHub Releases.
